subjectOutcomes.description: Build a functional Russian foundation for sound decoding, survival interaction and essential administration before/at arrival.
Operate in preparatory-class and everyday university contexts with growing grammar, listening, reading, writing and interaction control.
Follow university instruction, read formal material, take notes, explain technical/mathematical content and participate in academic interaction.
Use Russian for technical study, software/data/AI/control topics, experiments and academic reporting.
Perform research-oriented reading, evidence handling, seminar argumentation and НИР production.
Produce ВКР-oriented writing/presentation and defend technical/research choices under live questioning.

competencies.description: Distinguish and produce Russian sound-pattern features needed for intelligible learning and speech.
Recognize lexical items and meanings in context using verified lexical authority.
Recognize form-function grammar patterns in context.
Extract gist, detail, sequence, intent and task-relevant information from Russian audio.
Produce controlled and increasingly spontaneous Russian speech appropriate to task and context.
Read functional, academic and technical Russian for task-relevant meaning and structure.
Retrieve and use verified lexical items, collocations and government patterns productively.
Use grammar form-function patterns productively with appropriate control.
Produce functional, academic and technical written Russian for a defined purpose and audience.
Manage two-way Russian interaction, clarification, repair, role changes and unexpected turns.
Perform university discourse functions such as define, explain, compare, justify, summarize and respond.
Understand and produce Russian for technical concepts, procedures, data, systems and experiments.
Read, write, present and defend research work from evidence through НИР/ВКР and defense Q&A.
